_comment: Questions asked of the real chat pipeline by scripts/demo/generate_demo_conversations.py. Each `items` entry is an item id in the shipped bundle's manifest (bundle-v1). A question is asked in its own conversation, followed by its follow-ups. At least half of the conversations are cross-file. The privacy-redaction item id is reserved for the scripted clip that the owner still has to record (bundle-v1/privacy-demo/SCRIPT.md); until it exists in the manifest, the generator reports it as missing. Questions that name specifics (dates, topics) are drawn from the items' titles and must be rechecked against the transcripts once they exist.

conversations.title: How did VOA cover the 2026 US midterms in three languages?
questions: Summarize each of these three reports in two sentences and say which language each was in.
What do the reports say about why the president's party tends to lose midterm elections, and where do they agree or differ?
Which report gives the most detail about the 2026 result, and what did its speakers say?

conversations.title: What do the two Chinese-language reports cover?
questions: What is each report about, and who is quoted in them?
What does the Taiwan defense minister say about arms sales, and how does that compare with the energy story in the other report?

conversations.title: Which reports deal with security and conflict?
questions: Which of these reports are about security or conflict, and what does each say? Name the language of each.
Which report is a fact check, and what claim did it examine?
Compare the report on the Chagos Islands with the report on armed groups in Afghanistan: what concerns do they raise?

conversations.title: What did the Russian-language report say?
questions: Summarize this report in three bullet points and say who is speaking.

conversations.title: How did the NTSB open its bridge investigation meetings?
questions: For each meeting, what event was being investigated and what did the Chair say the Board would decide?
What do the three bridge investigations have in common, according to the staff and Board members who spoke?
Who presented for the NTSB staff in each meeting?

conversations.title: What did the Board conclude and vote on?
questions: What probable causes, findings or recommendations were discussed or voted on in these two meetings?
Which Board member raised the strongest concern, and what was it?

conversations.title: What were the FDA advisory committees asked to consider?
questions: For each meeting, which committee met and what product or question was it asked to consider?
Which meetings had the most committee members introduced, and what areas of expertise did they list?
How do the topics across these five meetings differ?

conversations.title: What happened in the Austin near-collision?
questions: Describe the incident and the system under review in each of these two meetings in two sentences each.
What did the Chair say about why each investigation matters for safety?

conversations.title: How did the Chair describe inflation across FOMC statements?

In which statements did the Chair say the Committee was raising, holding or lowering the policy rate, and what reasons were given?
What did the Chair say about the labor market in the earliest statement compared with the latest?

conversations.title: What changed in monetary policy during 2026?
questions: Summarize the policy decision announced in each of the four 2026 statements.
What risks did the Chair say the Committee was weighing in the October statement?

conversations.title: What did the SEC consider at its open meetings?

Which Commissioners voiced concerns, and what were they?
What did the staff say a proposed rule would require of companies or investors?

conversations.title: What did the Chair say in May 2022?
questions: What did the Chair say about the pace of rate increases and why?

conversations.title: What are the steps in the FEMA tribal recovery series?

What does the National Response Coordination Center do during a disaster?
What information does the registration intake video say an applicant needs?

What do the ocean and water cycle videos say about weather and climate, and how are they connected?

conversations.title: What is the Roman Space Telescope for?
